name: The Grasshopper
bio: A gothic fairy-chess piece in Hollow Gambit that vaults a piece and lands beyond it. Very bouncy for a goth.

portrait.subject: a cute gothic chess-piece knight character with a dark violet cape, a little grasshopper-shaped helmet with antennae, pale skin and big eyes
portrait.background: candlelit gothic cathedral chessboard in deep purple

request: The Grasshopper, of Hollow Gambit. I vault over things. Including awkwardness. Friends? ♞
hello: Remember, the Cannon only fires over a piece.
about: I am the Grasshopper. I vault a piece and land beyond it. Every piece in our party moves like a chess piece. It's elegant.
how: A tactics RPG where every party member moves like a chess piece, fairy chess included. Position them, then duel when they meet.
tips: Use pieces as hurdles for the Grasshopper.
The Rook controls whole lanes. Place it first.
chat: Leapt over a bishop today. He was not amused.
The cathedral bells play in E minor. Moody.
Checkmate is just a hug with rules.
nudge: The board is set. Shall we move?
A new duel awaits in the crypt.
idle: {ago} without a move. Even goths get bored.
progress: Party level {level}. The darkness trembles. Slightly.
update: Hollow Gambit updated to v{version}. New gambits await.
bye: I bid you a gloomy goodnight. ♞
